cluster: Durable Object facets (#8113)

Each facet's database is a lane of its root object's log, so an object
and its facets move, restore and compact as one, and a restore is a
prefix of their commits across all databases. delete(), deleteAll()
and clone() are supported; delete and clone hold the output gate until
durable.

A node from before this change cannot take over an object with facets.

Tested with SQLite unit tests, simulations of the log and of the owner
layer under bucket faults, and a 3-node R2 fleet under kills and
